# open-wispr

> Free, open-source, fully local voice dictation for macOS, powered exclusively by Parakeet TDT v3 through FluidAudio.

open-wispr is a lightweight menu bar app. Press a configurable hotkey, speak, and stop recording to insert the transcription at the cursor.

## Key facts

- Free and open source under the MIT license
- macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon
- Native Parakeet TDT v3 transcription through FluidAudio
- Microphone, system audio, or a mix of both
- Local processing with no account or cloud transcription
- Toggle and hold-to-talk modes
- Config stored at `~/.config/open-wispr/config.json`

## Common commands

```bash
open-wispr start
open-wispr status
open-wispr set-hotkey rightcmd
open-wispr set-language pl
open-wispr transcribe-file ./recording.wav
```

Parakeet downloads once on first launch and remains loaded while the app runs.
